title: Keeper report and tend can re-stake shutdown or emergency exit liquidity
impact: Keeper or management can undo emergency liquid-exit state by re-staking WETH after shutdown or emergency withdrawal, reducing user maxRedeem and immediately withdrawable liquidity.
preconditions: Strategy has idle WETH after emergencyWithdraw, manual swap, Lido claim, or stakeAsset=false flow; keeper or management calls tend or report after shutdown or while liquidity should remain idle.

evidence.detail: _harvestAndReport stakes loose WETH with no shutdown check
_tend stakes _totalIdle directly
TokenizedStrategy keeps tend/report callable after shutdown

All material gates passed; verifier classified as PoC-validated Medium.

title: Lido withdrawal initiation return data is not compatible with claim decoder
impact: Keeper using initiation return data directly claims the wrong request id, leaving pendingRedemptions nonzero and blocking reports until operators transform data or use privileged recovery.
preconditions: Management initiates a Lido withdrawal and keeper passes the returned bytes from initiateLSTWithdrawal directly to claimLSTWithdrawal.

evidence.detail: _initiateLSTWithdrawal returns abi.encode(requestIds) where requestIds is uint256[]
_claimLSTWithdrawal decodes _claimData as scalar uint256
reports revert while pendingRedemptions is nonzero

title: Strategy4626 deposit limit can ignore pre-existing loose WETH that will also be deployed
impact: A deposit that is individually within the Strategy4626 vault capacity can revert or re-deploy exit liquidity because inherited _deposit deploys all loose WETH, not just the new deposit.
preconditions: Strategy4626 has pre-existing loose WETH, deposits are open or caller is allowlisted, and the configured ERC4626 vault has finite maxDeposit capacity.

evidence.detail: inherited _deposit deploys _asset.balanceOf(address(this)) after transfer
availableDepositLimit checks vault.maxDeposit(address(this)) for new capacity
_stake deposits all wstETHBalance into the vault without a second capacity check
No PoC run; source trace and verifier gate review support deployment-conditional reachability.
Reachability and math gates pass conditionally when loose WETH and finite vault capacity exist.

dedupe_key: strategy4626 maxDeposit check excludes idle WETH deployed by inherited deposit
notes: Deployment-conditional; severity is lower if deposits stay closed or vault capacity is unlimited.

title: Factory-created Strategy4626 disables profit locking, enabling report-front-run dilution
impact: A depositor can enter before a predictable report at stale accounting and share immediately recognized unreported vault gains that accrued to prior shareholders.
preconditions: Factory-created Strategy4626 has public or attacker-allowlisted deposits, material unreported vault gains, zero profitMaxUnlockTime, and a predictable keeper report.

evidence.detail: factory sets profitMaxUnlockTime to zero
deposits mint against last recorded accounting before totalAssets update
report updates totalAssets from harvestAndReport
Strategy4626 value includes vault convertToAssets
No PoC run; verifier classified as plausible deployment-conditional economic finding.
Gates pass only under public deposits, material unreported gains, and predictable report timing.

dedupe_key: zero profit unlock allows stale accounting report front-run dilution
notes: Deployment-conditional; low if deposits remain closed or allowlisted and reports are sequenced defensively.

title: Strategy4626 trusts external ERC4626 share minting, NAV, and liveness without local guards
impact: If an unsafe ERC4626 vault is selected and opened, deposits can receive zero or dust vault shares, reports can use false NAV, or exits can be blocked by maxRedeem/redeem behavior.
preconditions: Configured vault passes asset()==wstETH but has malicious, paused, manipulable, or nonstandard ERC4626 behavior; management opens deposits or routes funds into it.

evidence.detail: constructor only checks vault asset equals wstETH
_stake ignores returned shares from vault.deposit
valueOfWstETH trusts vault.convertToAssets
_freeStETH trusts previewWithdraw, maxRedeem, and redeem
No malicious vault PoC run in this adapter pass.
Verifier classified as plausible deployment-conditional, not proven against the example vault.
